persona: Junior FPGA engineer at a defence radar firm
resumeText:
Arjun Reddy | Hyderabad | arjun.reddy@example.com

EXPERIENCE
FPGA Engineer, Deccan Radar Systems, Hyderabad (2021 - present)
- Write Verilog RTL for radar signal-processing blocks on Xilinx Kintex UltraScale FPGAs.
- Integrate Xilinx IP cores over AXI4-Stream and AXI4-Lite interfaces in Vivado.
- Close timing at 250 MHz by adding pipeline stages and writing XDC constraints.
- Debug designs on the lab bench with ChipScope ILA cores and JTAG.
- Wrote Tcl scripts that run synthesis and implementation builds overnight.
- Designed finite state machines for a UART-based control interface.

Graduate Engineer Trainee, Godavari Electronics, Hyderabad (2020 - 2021)
- Tested PCB assemblies and logged faults.

SKILLS
Verilog, VHDL, Vivado, MATLAB, Tcl, SerDes, Python

EDUCATION
BTech ECE, JNTU Hyderabad, 2020
